contentLanguage.description: Content language of the story catalogue ("Masal dili"). Must be one of the enabled content languages (400 CONTENT_LANGUAGE_NOT_ENABLED otherwise). Pass null to go back to the default language.

settings.description: Partial update for the settings bag. Shallow-merged into the existing object — top-level keys in the provided object fully replace their prior value; unrelated keys are preserved. Full merged payload must stringify to <=4KB.

storyId.description: ID of the story to narrate

voiceProfileId.description: ID of the voice profile to use

replace.description: When true, drop any existing narration for this (story, voice) pair (cascading its audio) before creating the fresh one. Default false.

text.description: Custom preview text (max 300 characters). Defaults to a short sample in the language of the voice.

kind.description: PRESET = ready-made voice, CLONE = user recorded voice

consentAt.description: ISO time of the KVKK clone consent (CLONE only)

language.description: Locale as stored on the profile

contentLanguage.description: Normalised content language code of the voice (tr, en), same vocabulary as story.language. A clone: the language the user chose to speak. A ready-made voice: the language it was added for.

isPremium.description: Premium (HD) voice, same rule as the narration quota

provider.description: GOOGLE = ready-made narrator voice (PRESET). CARTESIA = start a voice clone (CLONE); only voiceId "custom-cloning-pending" is accepted.

voiceId.description: GOOGLE: a voice id from GET /voice-profiles/available-voices (required). CARTESIA: "custom-cloning-pending" (may be omitted).

language.description: CARTESIA (clone): the language the user will speak in the recording, one of supportedLanguages of GET /voice-profiles/clone-config ("tr", "en"; a locale such as "en-US" is accepted). Default tr. It selects the reading script and consent text, is stored on the profile and is sent to Cartesia as the clone language. GOOGLE (ready-made): optional and informational, the language always comes from the voice id.
Language the user will speak in the recording (tr, en). Default tr.

consentVersion.description: Consent text version the user accepted (must equal clone-config consentVersion).

speechStartMs.description: Client-detected speech onset in milliseconds (integer >= 0, sent as a string). The server trims leading silence up to 250 ms before it.

signedTransaction.description: StoreKit 2 signed transaction (JWS, Transaction.jwsRepresentation; expo-iap: purchase.purchaseToken on iOS). Buy with appAccountToken = the Sesly user id.

productId.description: Product id the app believes it bought (informational; the signed transaction decides).

userId.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. The purchase is always bound to the authenticated user.

purchaseToken.description: Purchase token from Google Play Billing (buy with obfuscatedAccountId = the Sesly user id)

productId.description: Product id (subscription id) the app bought: mini_monthly, pro_monthly or pro_yearly. Unknown ids are rejected (PRODUCT_UNKNOWN).

packageName.description: Package name of the app; when sent it must be GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME (default com.sesly).

userId.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. The purchase is always bound to the authenticated user.

text.description: Full story text, paragraphs separated by a blank line

contentWarnings.description: Content warnings: SCARY (Korkutucu sahne), VIOLENCE (Şiddet), DEATH (Ölüm), SAD_ENDING (Üzücü son), BAD_EXAMPLE (Kötü davranış örneği), OLD_LANGUAGE (Eski dil / ağır anlatım), LONELINESS (Yalnızlık / ayrılık)

translationMethod.description: MACHINE: this text is our AI translation (the app shows "Yapay zekâ ile çevrildi"); HUMAN: a human translation

translatedFrom.description: Language of the story in the same pairKey this text was translated from (needs pairKey, differs from language). Sets translatedFromId.

pairKey.description: Same key on a tr and an en story: one translation group (one story per language)

partOf.description: Same key on every part of one tale (per language); needs partNumber

batch.description: Label of this import (the panel sends the file name; every request of one file sends the same label). Stored as Story.importBatch for the review view. Absent: the import date (YYYY-MM-DD).

requireReviewed.description: Only publish stories marked "İncelendi" (the review view sends true); the others are skipped

expectedCount.description: Number of stories the admin was shown in the confirmation (delete-preview). A different count is refused.

confirm.description: The word the admin typed to confirm

keys.description: File names without extension (the batch images are named <slug>.<ext>): matched to a tale by pairKey, partOf or slug

reviewed.description: true marks the story "İncelendi", false takes the mark away

coverCredit.description: Credit of the picture as JSON text: { illustrator, licenseName, licenseUrl, source, attribution }; a <slug>.credit.json is accepted as it is. Absent or blank: the picture needs no credit.
